% glossaries without hyperref, sorted by xindy, with a UTF-8 accent and no
% sort key, acronyms in the footnote style, and every glossary printed by
% \printglossaries
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[acronym,xindy]{glossaries}
\makeglossaries
\newglossaryentry{group}{name={group},
  description={a set with an associative operation}}
\newglossaryentry{etale}{name={étale},
  description={flat and unramified}}
\newglossaryentry{abelian}{name={abelian},
  description={with a commutative operation}}
\setacronymstyle{footnote}
\newacronym{gcd}{GCD}{greatest common divisor}
\begin{document}
\section{Groups}
An \gls{abelian} \gls{group} is \gls{etale}. The \gls{gcd} divides, and
the \gls{gcd} again.
\printglossaries
\end{document}
